{{Quote|No vessels, Lord Vader. But there is a small Imperial garrison on Jaguada.|Appo, to Darth Vader|<ref name="DL" />}}
'''Jaguada''' was a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and the only inhabited world of the [[Jaguada system/Legends|Jaguada system]], located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]. It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Jaguada's star|star]] and had one [[Jaguada's moon|moon]]. A [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that was [[Sith Empire expansion|settled]] around [[27,700 BBY]], Jaguada remained a part of both the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|ancient Sith Empire]] and the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]]. By [[533 BBY]], it was the site of a [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] constructed by the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth Gravid]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Gean]]. Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], they fought a [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|duel]] there that [[Death/Legends|cost]] Gravid his life.

Jaguada was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for storage of war machinery during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Near the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of that conflict, it hosted a [[Jaguada garrison|garrison]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], ostensibly to recover the Separatist technology that had been abandoned on the planet and its moon. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] was ordered to pursue the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|surviving]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Roan Shryne]] and his companions, who were hiding on Jaguada's [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was speculated that Jaguada was one of the ancient [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]] of the Sith and that it had been [[Scout/Legends|explored]] and [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The Jaguada system, Lord Vader. More precisely, the moon of the system's only inhabited world.|An Internal Security Bureau technician, to Darth Vader|<ref name="DL" />}}
Jaguada was the only inhabited [[Planet/Legends|world]] of the [[Jaguada system/Legends|eponymous system]],<ref name="DL" /> located in the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA Jaguada" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a [[Jaguada's star|star]] that was dying<ref name="DL" /> by [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> and was in turn circled by a [[Jaguada's moon|single]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]].<ref name="DL" /> It lay along the [[Kamat Aegit]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] between the planets [[Ashas Ree/Legends|Ashas Ree]] and [[Khar Delba]], while the [[Kamat Krote]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked Jaguada to the world of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="TEA Jaguada" /> The planet had an [[Water/Legends|arid]] climate, and its surface was covered in [[Desert/Legends|deserts]].<ref name="DL" />

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|Following the invasion of Korriban by the Rakata, the Sith gained access to their rudimentary hyperspace technology, and carried these scripts to worlds such as Ziost, Jaguada, and Tund.|Doctor Milanda Vorgan, "The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic"|<ref name="TWW" />}}
[[File:ThreeSith-BOS.png|thumb|right|300px|Members of the Sith species (pictured) colonized Jaguada after the Korriban civil war.]]
After an [[Invasion of Korriban|invasion]] by the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="END:TSD">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref> and a [[Korriban civil war|civil war]]<ref name="GH07">{{TORcite|type=codex|Galactic History 07: The First Spaceflights}}</ref> on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] around [[27,700 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> surviving members of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] species [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] Jaguada with Rakatan [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], bringing the [[High Sith]] and [[Common Sith]] [[Writing/Legends|scripts]] with them and [[Sith Empire expansion|integrating]] the planet into the [[Sith Empire (Pre-Republic)|ancient Sith Empire]].<ref name="TWW" /> Around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], Jaguada was under the control of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|old Sith Empire]]<ref name="TEA Jaguada" /> that was formed by the [[Exiles|Jedi Exiles]] in [[6900 BBY]].<ref name="EGttF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

===Order of the Sith Lords===
{{Quote|Their Order might have already been decimated had it not been for the setback Darth Gravid dealt the Sith.|Darth Plagueis, to Darth Sidious, regarding Darth Gravid's role in hindering the Grand Plan against the Jedi Order|<ref name="DP" />}}
[[File:Transfer_in_clone_body_BoS.jpg|thumb|left|300px|On Jaguada, Darth Gravid destroyed generations of Sith knowledge, including all traces of the essence transfer ability (pictured).]]
By [[533 BBY]],<ref name="Note">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}} establishes that [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] 46 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[46 BBY/Legends|46 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Chapter 25 of [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] establishes that Amidala had "only just turned thirteen," [[Darth Gravid]]'s reign "elapsed some five [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] earlier," and that he [[Death/Legends|died]] in that [[Time/Legends|time]], thus placing that chapter in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]] and Gravid's death around [[533 BBY]].</ref> the [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth Gravid]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Gean]], constructed a [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] on Jaguada. Gravid came to believe that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] should merge their [[Sith training|teachings]] with [[Jedi training/Legends|those]] of the Jedi, and those attempts drove him increasingly mad.<ref name="DP" />

Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Note" /> Gravid&mdash;who had concluded that his repository of [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]] and [[Book/Legends|tomes]] needed to be destroyed so that he could rebuild the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]]&mdash;raised [[Force barrier/Legends|Force barriers]] around the Jaguada [[Fortress/Legends|bastion]] and began eradicating generations worth of knowledge inside, including all traces of the [[essence transfer]] [[Force power/Legends|ability]]. Gean broke through the shields around the stronghold and [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|confronted]] her master in a [[Duel in Darth Gravid's bastion|duel]]. During the fight, Gean was gravely injured after Gravid [[Cho mok/Legends|cleaved off]] one of her [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and shoulders as well as the left side of her face and chest. However, Gean gained the upper hand, killing Gravid despite being unarmed.<ref name="DP" />

===The Clone Wars and beyond===
{{Quote|Your goal couldn't be more noble. And for all I know there are five hundred Jedi scattered throughout the Rim in need of rescue. My point is, I don't want to see your name added to the casualty list. What happened at Jaguada is only a foretaste of what's in store for us if we continue to band together.|Roan Shryne, to Olee Starstone|<ref name="DL" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] stored war machinery on Jaguada. Near the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of that conflict, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had established a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Jaguada garrison|garrison]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in Jaguada's [[Unidentified population center|population center]],<ref name="DL" /> ostensibly to recover the Separatist technology that had been abandoned on the planet<ref name="CSWE" /> and its moon. The [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] would later serve the Republic's successor, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="DL" /> In 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Drunk Dancer]]'' arrived in a stationary orbit on the moon's far side without being detected by the local garrison. [[Roan Shryne]], [[Olee Starstone]], and several other [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] survivors then landed in a [[Dropship/Legends|dropship]] at the moon's [[Separatist communications facility]] and used its equipment to remotely access the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] on the world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DL" />

[[File:DarkLordJapaneseCoverArt.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Darth Vader (in the foreground) ordered the Jaguada garrison to pursue Roan Shryne and his companions.]]
Their activities were detected from the [[Jedi Temple central security station/Legends|Temple beacon room]] by the Imperial [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Internal Security Bureau]] [[Chief/Legends|chief]], [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]], and his crew of ISB [[Technician/Legends|technicians]], who traced the group to Jaguada's moon and relayed the information to [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. As a large [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]] displaying the Jaguada [[Star system/Legends|system]], including the planet and its moon, emerged before Vader, he stepped into the [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] and indicated Jaguada's moon in it. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] relayed information on the location to Vader, including the fact that an Imperial garrison was present on Jaguada. Vader then had Appo order the [[Unidentified garrison commander (Jaguada)|garrison commander]] to pursue Shryne and his cohorts.<ref name="DL" />

Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], several [[Shadowfeed/Legends|shadowfeeds]] claimed that Jaguada, alongside the planets [[Begeren]] and Korriban, as well as the moon [[Khar Shian]], had been [[Scout/Legends|explored]] and [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] by the Galactic Empire. Others speculated that those worlds were possibly ancient homeworlds of the Sith.<ref name="FaD CR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> In [[38 ABY]], Jaguada was mentioned in the [[Xenolinguist/Legends|xenolinguist]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Milanda Vorgan]]'s article "[[The Written Word: A Brief Introduction to the Writing Systems of Galactic Basic]]."<ref name="TWW" />

==Inhabitants==
Around 27,700 BBY,<ref name="TEA" /> the Sith species settled Jaguada and brought the High Sith and Common Sith scripts there before eventually vanishing from the world.<ref name="TWW" /> By 19 BBY,<ref name="TERC" /> Jaguada maintained a modest population and hosted a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] garrison.<ref name="DL" />

==Locations==
Jaguada was the site of a bastion constructed by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Gravid and his apprentice, Darth Gean,<ref name="DP" /> by 533 BBY.<ref name="Note" /> Additionally, a population center was located on the planet.<ref name="DL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaguada was introduced in the [[2005]] novel ''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]'', written by [[James Luceno]]. Apart from being mentioned in the novel, the planet also appeared in a holographic representation of the entire Jaguada system.<ref name="DL" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA Jaguada" /> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]], misleadingly claims that Jaguada<ref name="TERC" />&mdash;instead of Jaguada's moon specifically<ref name="DL" />&mdash;was "visited," and therefore made a full appearance, during the events of ''Dark Lord''.<ref name="TERC" />
